name: Thomas
background: Called 'the Twin.' He is distinguished by his analytical and skeptical mindset, requiring evidence before confirming his faith.

genericReactions.physical: Unless I see the mark of the nails and put my finger in the wounds, I will not believe.
genericReactions.testimonial: The others say they have seen him. I need more than words.
genericReactions.digital: Show me the record. Let me examine it for myself.
genericReactions.environmental: He appeared in a locked room. How is that possible?
genericReactions.analytical: I need tangible proof. Evidence I can touch and see.
genericReactions.prophecy: He said he would rise. I need to see it to believe it.
